MORE: This is to inform you that pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held today i.e. 13th August, 2026 has considered and approved the Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026, along with the Limited Review Report of the auditors thereon.
